name: harness-kit
description: A cloneable personal harness for working with AI agents: a hot canon of hard rules, self-learning, knowledge and activities that survive sessions, an agent-owned structure, and a concierge stance. One base follows the person across their computer, their phone and any agent working for them — `/harness-sync` keeps those in step and `/harness-update` brings the kit half up to date without ever touching what they wrote. `/harness-init` sets up a fresh base, `/harness-project-init` gives a project the contract an agent needs to open it cold, `/harness-add-skill` runs the skill-creation gate, `/harness-doctor` health-checks the base. Solo, cross-agent (Claude / Codex / Cursor), domain-agnostic.
